review.summary: Adds App\Ops\DiscordOpsAlert with config-driven Discord webhook delivery, redaction, multibyte truncation and soft-fail logging, plus the daily/audit/stack logging lanes, env keys, a phpunit pin and an ops decision guide. The implementation matches the task, but it ships with no tests at all and the docs/CHANGELOG are not kept in sync, so it needs changes before merging.
